title: Stabilis
description: A collection of the best performance mods available to achieve the smoothest experience
body:
The Stabilis modpack is built to deliver the fastest Minecraft experience possible on Fabric 1.21.8. This pack brings together the best optimization mods currently available, carefully chosen and configured to ensure that every bit of performance is squeezed out of the game. It will work great on low end laptops and high end, reduces stutter, and a noticeably more responsive game.

This modpack is intentionally lightweight and minimal, meaning you won’t find vanilla experience changes. Instead, it serves as a good foundation you’re encouraged to add any quality-of-life, content, or aesthetic mods you want on top of it. I am looking to improve it with the constant
updates

My goal is to keep the pack as fast as possible to ensure maximum performance, minimum clutter.
If you have feedback, suggestions, or encounter issues while adding your own mods, I am ready to help.
